author: PieZ
body:
Hello. K_R_Cord and I have decided that our next community event will be the highly requested Throwback event. Since I came here at the end of the Throwback era and Kord only knows what a Quintus is, we will be leaving it up to you guys to make up the rotation on your guy's request. We will be doing only 10 maps for time purposes and if this is successful we will be doing this more often. Here is the information below:

Date: Friday, June 23 *Date can change so please check the thread regularly

Time: 4 PM EDT *Time can change so please check the thread regularly

Server: /sv Community01 
         TS: ts.avicus.net (We will be playing together in TS)

Rotation:
Luar Origins
Mystic
Venoumous
Rigor Mortis
Ravanged
Ternio
Fantasy (Orcs vs Elves version) 
Gladiator
Decay
Quintus Origins

Rotation is complete!
